### Step 3 — Plan shape

A plan holds only what a person wrote: its header, `## Goal`, `## Tasks`, and one `## T<n> — <title>` section per row for what a person has to say about it (its research and rulings; the brief renders it). It holds no state, matrix or handoff section, and its rows are the nine cells `operational-rules.md` gives; the write hook refuses either, and a header key the log now holds. The step, each row's state and the delivery are asked of the run's log: `bash <plugin-root>/scripts/reader.sh <plan> step`, or `status <id>`. Advance with `session-poker.sh current <N>`: judged as a commit at `<N>` would be, then one step event.

**Task-scale variant.** Requirements go under `## Requirements`, each a `### REQ-<n> — <title>` heading with a `provenance:` line (the Step-1 card renders them). The register is the one `## Tasks` table; the reviews its rigor deals (review proofs, or a waiver) are owed from Step 6. The plan's author writes `base-sha: <the commit the work started from>` (`git rev-parse HEAD` then) in its frontmatter: without it the first review is refused. Beside it the author writes `working-branch: <the branch the work is built on>`: without it `proof-add`, `waive` and `current 8` refuse.

**A `## Tasks` cell opens on a title of at most 30 characters,** then a period and the detail; the card prints the title, refuses a longer one and never cuts it; `show task <n>` prints the whole cell.

**A row's tree is an event.** `spawn-worktree.sh create --for <name>` records it. A commit from it is judged by that row — its step at wave scale, its task arms at task scale — never by the run's step, and a row ahead of the run is refused.

`## Assumptions` points to `record/<wave>/assumptions.md` — seeded from Step 1's "Not Doing" plus spec ambiguities; Step 4 appends there before each commit.

Tag every Step-4 task `complexity: standard | complex`; when uncertain, `complex`. The card's agent column takes its role from that tag for a build or a test row, `complex` as senior-implementor and `standard` as implementor, and prints a dash for every other kind and for a row with no tag.

**Plan for width.** Split a task on the longest chain wherever it can be split. Where two tasks
write one file, let them run side by side and reconcile on landing; a file that cannot be merged
(`!` in `Files`) gets one short first task. A row names another in `deps` only where it reads what
that row writes.

**Step 3 approves the plan and the matrix only**, against the card below; the design was
approved on the Step-2 card.

**The gate is the literal word `approved`, and nothing else is.** Silence, a question, or a
partial reply is never transcribed as approval. On that word run
`session-poker.sh approve plan '<verbatim reply>'`: one approval event in the run's log.

While no approval of the plan stands the evidence gate refuses every commit at step 4 or later, and
dispatch-preflight refuses every writer-class dispatch (implementor, senior-implementor). Both
walls, and the fails-when wall beside them, bind at every scale. No row is ready before it.

On approval, build the task list from the plan before the first dispatch: one `<step>/<n>: <title>` entry per `## Tasks` row, then one `<step>: <desc>` entry per remaining step. A row born after that owes one entry, added at the end of the list. Mark a row's entry in progress in the turn it is dispatched.

```
Step 3 · Plan

  Branches
    working       <branch>              (from <base> @ <sha>)
    integration   <branch>              (Step 8 merges here)

  Tasks                                  serves       kind      depends      agent
    <n>   <the task title>               <REQ-n>      build     —            senior-implementor
    <n>   <the task title>               <REQ-n>      doc       <n>          —

  Chain and width
    longest chain  <n> → <n> → <n> · <minutes> min
    peak width     <n> of <writers> writers
    batch <n> · <n> of <n>

  Verification
    <n> matrix rows · regression <yes|no> · walk <required|exempt> · auditor <rigor>

  Artifacts
    plan  <docs-root>/plans/epic-NN-<slug>/wave-NN-<slug>.plan.md
    spec  <docs-root>/specs/epic-NN-<slug>/wave-NN-<slug>.spec.md

Do you approve this plan? Reply "approved" to approve it.
show evals <req> · show task <n> · explain <decision>
```

Card: `bash <plugin-root>/scripts/card.sh step3 <plan.md>` renders it whole; no stdin.

**Wave shape locks at approval, and changes only by re-plan**, on a finding, a red test, an approved scope change, a task overrunning its size, a report naming follow-up work. A row is changed by an edit, and added by one: every cell its header carries, a review row's task cell ending ` · questions: <q>[,<q>]` when it owes fewer than its rigor deals, a born row's ` · born: review` or ` · born: regression`; then `session-poker.sh task-add <id>` records its birth (`--born <record>#<n>`, `--born regression:<suite>`), the plan unwritten. A pending row no longer owed is dropped by `session-poker.sh task-add <id> --drop '<the person's words>'`, the plan unwritten. A short row is refused with the lines to paste; a refused birth leaves the row unborn, the person's to remove. Any other discovery is a W+1 candidate; one that makes the wave impossible surfaces a Wake Note and halts.
